scope: Minimal Abaqus/CAE 2024 noGUI probe for Region, Set, GeomSequence, BC/load, and face-surface consumer ownership; no input write, job submission, or solve.

repeated_product_signatures: setElementType regions[0] received FaceArray/GeomSequence at the wrong wrapper level
SectionAssignment region received raw FaceArray/CellArray/EdgeArray instead of Region/Set
boundary/load region received raw geometry instead of a Region object
Assembly.Surface received flat host-Python geometry containers
selection_basis.reason: These ownership errors recurred across plate, 3D bar, beam, and model-change runs and each consumed a real CAE call.

Part.setElementType.regions.2d_face_array: bare native array rejected; tuple containing the native array accepted; direct Set accepted; tuple containing Set rejected
Part.setElementType.regions.3d_cell_array: same dispatch as the 2D face array
Part.setElementType.regions.1d_edge_array: same dispatch as the 2D face array
Part.setElementType.regions.invariant: geometry arrays need the geometry-sequence wrapper branch, while a Set must be passed directly

Model.DisplacementBC.region.assembly_set: accepted and created the boundary-condition repository entry
Model.DisplacementBC.region.part_set: constructor accepted it in this no-solve probe; no solver-level ownership claim is made

Model.ConcentratedForce.region.assembly_set: accepted and created the load repository entry
Model.ConcentratedForce.region.part_set: constructor accepted it in this no-solve probe; no solver-level ownership claim is made
